SYN-QUANT-001.trigger: Extreme temporary synthetic liquidity imbalance defined before any outcome inspection.
SYN-QUANT-001.payer_or_forced_actor: Temporary liquidity demander crossing a constrained synthetic book.
SYN-QUANT-001.structural_reason: Urgency and inventory pressure can create transient dislocation independent of long-run value.
SYN-QUANT-001.expression: Frozen cross-sectional ranking and short-horizon reversal expression; parameters remain preregistered.
SYN-QUANT-001.universe_definition: Synthetic equity universe with identity, venue and calendar eligibility frozen at decision time.
disconfirmation_checks: pressure proxy lacks causal relation to urgency

SYN-FUND-001.issuer_identity: Synthetic issuer identity frozen with stable entity mapping and security lineage.
SYN-FUND-001.financial_statements: Point-in-time synthetic income statement, balance sheet and cash-flow statement vintages.
SYN-FUND-001.earnings_and_guidance: Earnings release and guidance versions separated by first-publication clock.
SYN-FUND-001.estimate_revisions: Consensus-state design field only; no post-freeze realized revision outcome consumed.
SYN-FUND-001.valuation_frame: Predeclared multiple and cash-flow valuation frame with scenario bounds, not target-price fitting.
SYN-FUND-001.balance_sheet_quality: Debt, liquidity, maturity and working-capital diagnostics defined ex ante.
SYN-FUND-001.cash_flow_quality: Cash conversion, capex intensity and working-capital bridge defined ex ante.
SYN-FUND-001.competitive_position: Synthetic market position, pricing power and substitution risks encoded as falsifiable claims.
disconfirmation_checks: valuation gap is explained by balance-sheet risk

SYN-EVENT-001.event_identity: Synthetic guidance-document revision with immutable document pair identity.
SYN-EVENT-001.document_clock: First-publication clock frozen independently from later amendments.
SYN-EVENT-001.eligibility_rule: Only documents satisfying predeclared issuer, document-type and timing rules are admissible.
SYN-EVENT-001.novel_information: Structured change in guidance language classified before any market response is accessed.
SYN-EVENT-001.diffusion_hypothesis: Information may diffuse through analyst and investor processing with a bounded lag.
disconfirmation_checks: revision classification depends on later knowledge

SYN-FLOW-001.forced_actor: Synthetic benchmark-constrained or mandate-constrained institutional holder.
SYN-FLOW-001.constraint_rule: Predeclared rebalance or eligibility rule that creates non-discretionary demand or supply.
SYN-FLOW-001.implementation_clock: Announcement and effective implementation clocks kept separate.
SYN-FLOW-001.affected_universe: Synthetic securities meeting frozen index or mandate eligibility rules.
SYN-FLOW-001.expected_footprint: Temporary pressure around the implementation window followed by potential normalization; no realized footprint inspected.
SYN-FLOW-001.capacity_constraints: Capacity depends on ADV, participation, crowding and implementation concentration and remains unqualified for the current Flow candidate.
disconfirmation_checks: same exposure already exists in legacy knowledge
